title: Semester dates (edit me)
body: Example: Fall 2026 classes 1 Oct–15 Jan. Midterm week 10–14 Nov. Finals 5–16 Jan. Replace this FAQ with your registrar calendar before inviting students.

title: Scholarship and waiver (edit me)
body: Need-based tuition waiver: apply at the registrar with an income certificate. Merit list: typically CGPA 3.75+. Deadlines are campus-specific — paste the real notice here so Campus answers from this knowledge base, not the public web.

title: Helping Hand Crew channels
body: Use #study-lab for concepts and quizzes (Tutor), #assignment-desk for outlines and citations (Writer), #campus-desk for deadlines and scholarships (Campus), #focus-room for study plans and reminders (Focus). Captain greets, routes, and tracks quota. One specialist replies per question.

title: Club Discord house rules
body: Writer will not ghostwrite a full assignment. Free members get 15 AI messages per day; Crew Member role gets 80/day after the club treasurer confirms bKash/Nagad. Ask an admin to run /grant.
